producer.name: Isekado
producer.about: Isekado is the beer arm of Nikenchaya Mochi Kadoya Honten, a family business in Ise, Mie, that began in 1575 as a teahouse at a boat landing. It still makes rice cakes, miso and soy sauce, and the family is now in its twenty-first generation.

spec.label: Flavouring or botanicals
spec.value: Strata, Citra, Mosaic (double dry-hopped); Incognito in the whirlpool
